description: This file defines the `CookieJar` class in the GuzzleHttp library, implementing cookie storage and management functionalities for HTTP requests and responses.

classes.name: CookieJar
classes.description: Implements a cookie container that stores cookies for HTTP requests, supporting operations like adding, retrieving, and clearing cookies, along with cookie parsing from responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a CookieJar instance, optionally with strict mode and preloaded cookies.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Creates a CookieJar from an associative array of cookies for a specified domain.

methods.name: shouldPersist
methods.description: Determines if a cookie should be persisted based on its attributes and session allowance.

methods.name: getCookieByName
methods.description: Retrieves a cookie by its name.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Exports stored cookies as an array.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes cookies based on domain, path, and name filters.

methods.name: clearSessionCookies
methods.description: Removes session cookies from the jar.

methods.name: setCookie
methods.description: Adds a cookie to the jar after validation and resolves conflicts.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of stored cookies.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the stored cookies.

methods.name: extractCookies
methods.description: Parses ’Set-Cookie’ headers from a response and adds cookies to the jar.

methods.name: getCookiePathFromRequest
methods.description: Calculates the default cookie path following RFC 6265.

methods.name: withCookieHeader
methods.description: Applies stored cookies to an outgoing request by adding a Cookie header.

methods.name: removeCookieIfEmpty
methods.description: Removes cookies if their value is null or empty, based on the domain, path, and name.
